title: Advanced Prompting Workshop Notes
body_markdown:
At the end of 2024, I presented a workshop on advanced prompting techniques. We had a great turnout and a lively discussion, and several people have asked for a writeup of the event.


You can access the notes on[Our Notion](https://gloochat.notion.site/BAML-Advanced-Prompting-Workshop-Dec-2024-161bb2d26216807b892fed7d9d978a37) .


If you missed the workshop back in December, it's not to late to check out the content. If you're interested in these topics, join our[Discord](https://boundaryml.com/discord) and chat with like minded prompters!
